sentences.zh: 新罕布什尔州的选民非常独立。

sentences.en: The results of Iowa really aren't going to impact how New Hampshire votes.
sentences.zh: 艾奥瓦州的结果真的不会影响新罕布什尔州的投票方式。

sentences.en: Oh, good Lord, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪，当然不会。

sentences.en: They're in another country, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们就像在另一个国家一样。

sentences.en: You need a passport to go to Iowa from New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 从新罕布什尔州去艾奥瓦州都需要护照。

sentences.en: Depending on the result, it might, it might.
sentences.zh: 取决于结果，也许会，也许会吧。

sentences.en: I don't know, just maybe seeing what those people think could influence what I'm thinking as well.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，也许看看那些人的想法会影响我的想法。

sentences.en: I don't know, I think it was interesting.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: Like, I don't think people expected Joe Biden to do as poorly as he did.
sentences.zh: 比如，我觉得人们没料到乔·拜登的表现会这么差。

sentences.en: Does that change how you view him?
sentences.zh: 这改变了你对他的看法吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 不，我不这么认为。

sentences.en: But I think it might other people, yeah.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这可能会影响其他人，是的。

sentences.en: Are you into him?
sentences.zh: 你支持他吗？

sentences.en: I'd say, like, 50%.
sentences.zh: 我会说，大概50%吧。

sentences.en: And who's the other 50?
sentences.zh: 那另外50%是谁？

sentences.en: Probably Mayor Pete.
sentences.zh: 可能是皮特市长。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But you don't think the fact that Pete did well and Biden did poorly impacts how you now make your decision?
sentences.zh: 但你不认为皮特表现好而拜登表现差，会影响你现在的决定吗？

sentences.en: Because I assume you want electability as a thing.
sentences.zh: 因为我假设你很看重胜选能力。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I think it would sway me a little bit more towards Mayor Pete.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，我想这会让我更倾向于皮特市长一点。

sentences.en: Just seeing the results there, yeah.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是看到那里的结果，是的。

sentences.en: So on Thursday afternoon, three days after the Iowa caucuses, with still no winner called...
sentences.zh: 所以周四下午，在艾奥瓦州党团会议结束三天后，依然没有宣布获胜者……

sentences.en: Okay, it's 3.15 on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在是周四下午3点15分。

sentences.en: We're at this Pete Buttigieg rally.
sentences.zh: 我们正在参加这场皮特·布蒂吉格的集会。

sentences.en: And they won't let us in because it's at capacity.
sentences.zh: 他们不让我们进去，因为已经满员了。

sentences.en: We show up at an American Legion Hall in Merrimack.
sentences.zh: 我们出现在梅里马克的一个美国退伍军人协会大厅。

sentences.en: And the room is already overflowing.
sentences.zh: 房间里已经挤满了人。

sentences.en: I'm standing on the stairs trying to get in.
sentences.zh: 我站在楼梯上试图挤进去。

sentences.en: And I can see about 40 people just outside also trying to get in.
sentences.zh: 我能看到外面大约有40个人也正试图进去。

sentences.en: And actually, before he goes on stage...
sentences.zh: 事实上，在他上台之前……

sentences.en: We are taking no vote for granted.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把任何一张选票视为理所当然。

sentences.en: Obviously, we feel a lot of momentum coming here.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们感觉到这里有很大的势头。

sentences.en: But I know how New Hampshire doesn't...
sentences.zh: 但我知道新罕布什尔州不会……

sentences.en: Is never told what to do.
sentences.zh: 从来不会被告知该怎么做。

sentences.en: Buttigieg comes outside and gives a little speech to everyone waiting outside in the freezing rain.
sentences.zh: 布蒂吉格走到外面，给在冰冷的雨中等待的所有人发表了简短的演讲。

sentences.en: So if you're here as a supporter, thank you so much for that.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是作为支持者来到这里，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: And please continue to spread the word.
sentences.zh: 请继续帮忙宣传。

sentences.en: If you're here to make up your mind, please stay tuned.
sentences.zh: 如果你是来做决定的，请保持关注。

sentences.en: We'll continue to be doing events all through the state and hope to earn that support as we go into Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续在全州范围内举办活动，并希望在周二到来之前赢得你们的支持。

sentences.en: Thanks so much again.
sentences.zh: 再次非常感谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: And after about 45 minutes of standing around...
sentences.zh: 在大约站了45分钟之后……

sentences.en: We're able to talk our way inside.
sentences.zh: 我们成功说服他们让我们进去了。

sentences.en: But to do what he just did, taking questions like that off the cuff...
sentences.zh: 但要做到他刚才那样，即兴回答问题……

sentences.en: And we meet this guy named Dave Hennessey, whose wife, he calls her the boss, had just wandered away.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了这个叫戴夫·亨尼西的人，他妻子——他称她为“老板”——刚才走开了。

sentences.en: She's going to decide for me tonight, probably, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想她今晚可能会替我做决定。

sentences.en: Is this your wife?
sentences.zh: 这是你妻子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's my wife.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是我妻子。

sentences.en: I've been torn between Biden and Pete.
sentences.zh: 我在拜登和皮特之间摇摆不定。

sentences.en: And I love Joe.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢乔。

sentences.en: And when I'm looking at him, my big reason for leaning towards Joe is I'm dead sure he can beat Trump.
sentences.zh: 当我看着他时，我倾向于乔的最大理由是我确信他能打败特朗普。

sentences.en: He's convincing me that he can, too.
sentences.zh: 他也在说服我他能做到。

sentences.en: He means Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 他指的是布蒂吉格。

sentences.en: To Iowa?
sentences.zh: 去艾奥瓦州？

sentences.en: Iowa's part of it.
sentences.zh: 艾奥瓦州是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: But the fact that he can think...
sentences.zh: 但事实上他能思考……

sentences.en: And I've seen it before.
sentences.zh: 而且我以前见过。

sentences.en: I've seen him doing this before.
sentences.zh: 我以前见过他这样做。

sentences.en: Being able to talk the way he does so quickly, so fast, he'll kill Trump in a debate.
sentences.zh: 能够如此迅速、如此敏捷地表达，他在辩论中会完胜特朗普。

sentences.en: Absolutely wipe him out.
sentences.zh: 绝对会彻底击垮他。

sentences.en: The fact that Pete seems like the winner there, we don't know, or like he did well, is compelling to you.
sentences.zh: 皮特似乎在那儿赢了——我们不知道，或者说他表现得很好——这对你很有吸引力。

sentences.en: It is compelling.
sentences.zh: 确实很有吸引力。

sentences.en: It does...
sentences.zh: 这确实……

sentences.en: I mean, let's put the elephant in the room on the table.
sentences.zh: 我是说，让我们把那个显而易见的问题摆到桌面上来谈吧。

sentences.en: The fact is, though, there are bigots out there.
sentences.zh: 事实是，确实存在偏执的人。

sentences.en: That moron woman out in...
sentences.zh: 那个在……的蠢女人。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I shouldn't say...
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不该说……

sentences.en: But the woman out in Iowa who just discovered Pete was gay and then said she wouldn't vote for him because the Bible wouldn't allow it.
sentences.zh: 但那个在艾奥瓦州的女人，她刚发现皮特是同性恋，然后就说她不会投票给他，因为《圣经》不允许。

sentences.en: I mean, there are people like that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，确实有那样的人。

sentences.en: Even today, in 2020, I think it's a problem.
sentences.zh: 即使在今天，2020年，我认为这仍然是个问题。

sentences.en: I hope to God that that kind of thinking isn't so widespread that would cost him the election.
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷那种想法不会广泛到让他输掉选举。

sentences.en: But it worries me because we've got to get Trump out of there.
sentences.zh: 但这让我担心，因为我们必须把特朗普赶下台。

sentences.en: Dave, are you worried about the moderate vote being split between Biden and Buttigieg?
sentences.zh: 戴夫，你担心温和派选票会在拜登和布蒂吉格之间被分散吗？

sentences.en: To be honest, no.
sentences.zh: 老实说，不担心。

sentences.en: Everybody, I think most people have the same opinion I have.
sentences.zh: 每个人，我想大多数人都有和我一样的看法。

sentences.en: We'd vote for a rock over Trump.
sentences.zh: 就算选块石头我们也投，只要不是特朗普。

sentences.en: So whoever wins, ultimately, the nominee is going to be anti-Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以无论谁最终获胜，提名人都会是反特朗普的。

sentences.en: And I think that's priority one, two, three, four, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是第一、第二、第三、第四等等优先事项。

sentences.en: We've got to beat this guy.
sentences.zh: 我们必须打败这家伙。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's a disgrace.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是个耻辱。

sentences.en: He's awful.
sentences.zh: 他太糟糕了。

sentences.en: All my friends, a lot of my friends who are Republicans, are not going to vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我所有的朋友，很多共和党的朋友，都不会投票给特朗普。

sentences.en: But I'm afraid they may sit out.
sentences.zh: 但我担心他们可能会弃权。

sentences.en: As we're talking, Dave's wife returns.
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈时，戴夫的妻子回来了。

sentences.en: All right, so the boss is back.
sentences.zh: 好了，老板回来了。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Are you decided or are you...
sentences.zh: 你决定了吗，还是……

sentences.en: I like Pete.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢皮特。

sentences.en: I think I'm going to go with Pete.
sentences.zh: 我想我会选皮特。

sentences.en: So you're going to sell him on it.
sentences.zh: 所以你要被他说服了。

sentences.en: He might split the vote.
sentences.zh: 他可能会分散选票。

sentences.en: He's done that before, but...
sentences.zh: 他以前做过，但是……

sentences.en: I mean, I like Joe, too, but he's just got so much energy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我也喜欢乔，但他（布蒂吉格）精力太充沛了。

sentences.en: Again, by he, she means Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，他说的是布蒂吉格。

sentences.en: To be clear, we both like Amy.
sentences.zh: 澄清一下，我们俩都喜欢艾米。

sentences.en: We like Amy a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们非常喜欢艾米。

sentences.en: With Amy.
sentences.zh: 支持艾米。

sentences.en: You're talking...
sentences.zh: 你在说……

sentences.en: You'll notice this is not an entirely satisfying answer.
sentences.zh: 你会注意到这并不是一个完全令人满意的回答。

sentences.en: Having now talked to a ton of voters, it feels like there's this thing going on, where a lot
sentences.zh: 在和大量选民交谈后，感觉发生了一件事，很多人

sentences.en: of people personally really like Amy Klobuchar, but they sort of assume not enough other people really like Amy Klobuchar.
sentences.zh: 个人非常喜欢艾米·克洛布查尔，但他们似乎认为没有足够多的人真正喜欢艾米·克洛布查尔。

sentences.en: And then we try a version of the moderate question again.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再次尝试了温和派问题的变体。

sentences.en: Do you think that it's more suitable for a moderate, like a Biden or a Pete or a Klobuchar, to go toe-to-toe with Trump?
sentences.zh: 你认为温和派，比如拜登、皮特或克洛布查尔，更适合与特朗普正面交锋吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think a progressive like Bernie Sanders is well-suited to go toe-to-toe with Trump?
sentences.zh: 还是你认为像伯尼·桑德斯这样的进步派更适合与特朗普正面交锋？

sentences.en: I think it's valid, but I'm not for Bernie.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有道理，但我不支持伯尼。

sentences.en: I know Bernie, I think, pretty well out of Burlington, back when he was mayor of Burlington.
sentences.zh: 我挺了解伯尼的，他在伯灵顿当市长的时候我就很了解他。

sentences.en: Socialism doesn't scare me and all that.
sentences.zh: 社会主义并不让我害怕，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I just don't think he can get his programs through Congress.
sentences.zh: 我只是不认为他能让他的计划在国会通过。

sentences.en: I don't think he can do it.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他能做到。

sentences.en: Are you worried that with the moderate vote being split between Pete Buttigieg and Joe Biden, that that fracturing will mean that Sanders ends up winning the nomination?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心温和派选票在皮特·布蒂吉格和乔·拜登之间被分散，这种分裂会导致桑德斯最终赢得提名？

sentences.en: I don't hear it.
sentences.zh: 我没听过这种说法。

sentences.en: Everybody I talk to is saying the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都说同样的话。

sentences.en: I may be for Bernie, I may be for this and that, but I'll support anybody who's the nominee for the Democratic Party to beat Trump.
sentences.zh: 我可能支持伯尼，我可能支持这个那个，但我会支持民主党的任何提名人来打败特朗普。

sentences.en: That's what I hear.
sentences.zh: 这就是我听到的。

sentences.en: You're not worried that, like you two said, that you're going to cancel each other out.
sentences.zh: 你不担心像你们俩刚才说的，你们会互相抵消吗？

sentences.en: So if you vote Biden...
sentences.zh: 所以如果你投给拜登……

sentences.en: At the Buttigieg rally, at least, this is not proving to be a fruitful line of questioning.
sentences.zh: 至少在布蒂吉格的集会上，这证明不是一个有效的提问方向。

sentences.en: It's clear Buttigieg's performance in Iowa is having an influence on some moderate New Hampshire Democrats.
sentences.zh: 很明显，布蒂吉格在艾奥瓦州的表现正在影响一些温和派的新罕布什尔州民主党人。

sentences.en: He's got momentum.
sentences.zh: 他有势头。

sentences.en: But the sort of calculation we're wondering about, people don't even seem to process the question we're asking them.
sentences.zh: 但我们好奇的那种计算，人们似乎根本没有处理我们问他们的问题。

sentences.en: It's so far outside the way they actually seem to be thinking.
sentences.zh: 这完全超出了他们实际思考的方式。

sentences.en: So we pack up and head to an Elizabeth Warren rally.
sentences.zh: 所以我们收拾东西前往伊丽莎白·沃伦的集会。

sentences.en: Warren seems to be in this funny no-man's land here in New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 沃伦在新罕布什尔州似乎处于一个有趣的无人区。

sentences.en: On the one hand, she's competing with liberal voters for Sanders, but they don't see her as authentic of a liberal choice.
sentences.zh: 一方面，她正在与桑德斯争夺自由派选民，但他们并不认为她是正统的自由派选择。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, more moderate voters see her big liberal policies as far too damaging to go up in a general election against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，更温和的选民认为她的大型自由派政策在对阵唐纳德·特朗普的大选中破坏性太大。

sentences.en: I'm a New Hampshire voter.
sentences.zh: 我是新罕布什尔州的选民。

sentences.en: I have no idea who I'm voting for.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道我要投给谁。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全不知道。

sentences.en: You're both totally undecided.
sentences.zh: 你们俩都完全没决定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全没决定。

sentences.en: That's why we're here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这里的原因。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got to listen.
sentences.zh: 是的，你得听听看。

sentences.en: So you find a lot of undecided people at Warren's events, trying to figure out what exactly they think.
sentences.zh: 所以你在沃伦的活动中会发现很多未决定的选民，试图弄清楚他们到底是怎么想的。

sentences.en: We're sisters.
sentences.zh: 我们是姐妹。

sentences.en: We're sisters.
sentences.zh: 我们是姐妹。

sentences.en: And, yeah, you couldn't tell.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，你看不出来。

sentences.en: No, now I see it.
sentences.zh: 不，现在我看出来了。

sentences.en: It's in the eyes.
sentences.zh: 看眼睛就知道了。

sentences.en: It's in the eyes.
sentences.zh: 看眼睛就知道了。

sentences.en: I'm the friend of the sisters.
sentences.zh: 我是这对姐妹的朋友。

sentences.en: And she's the friend of the sisters.
sentences.zh: 而她是这对姐妹的朋友。

sentences.en: And we meet these sisters, Mary and Nancy, with their friend Sue.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了这对姐妹，玛丽和南希，还有她们的朋友苏。

sentences.en: They're all retired, and they're all really conflicted about what they think about the race.
sentences.zh: 她们都退休了，而且对这场竞选的看法非常矛盾。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I'm very concerned because there are so many Democratic candidates that the vote is going to be split, and Trump is going to get in again.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心，因为有太多的民主党候选人，选票会被分散，特朗普会再次当选。

sentences.en: I mean, you can't have all of those, all of the candidates, to me, have good things and bad things about what they want.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你不能拥有所有这些，对我来说，所有的候选人在他们想要的东西上都有好有坏。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But when you've got five people, and actually there's more, but...
sentences.zh: 但当你有五个人选时，实际上还不止五个，但是……

sentences.en: Yeah, five people.
sentences.zh: 没错，五个人选。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I think the vote is going to be just so split that Trump's going to get in again.
sentences.zh: 我觉得选票会被分得太散，导致特朗普又要当选了。

sentences.en: So, first we're thinking, okay, here you go.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们首先想的是，好吧，给你看看这个。

sentences.en: This is the fractured vote thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是选票分散的问题。

sentences.en: So, do you have, like, any preference among those five?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这五个人里，你有偏好的人选吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I knew you were going to say that.
sentences.zh: 噢，我就知道你会这么问。

sentences.en: I knew you were.
sentences.zh: 我就知道你会。

sentences.en: And, frankly, I don't.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我没有。

sentences.en: I like Buttigieg, but sometimes I think he's so young.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢布蒂吉格，但有时我觉得他太年轻了。

sentences.en: He's very bright, but he's so young, I'm not sure if experience is what...
sentences.zh: 他非常聪明，但太年轻了，我不确定经验是否……

sentences.en: I mean, look, Trump had no experience at all, but...
sentences.zh: 我是说，你看，特朗普根本没有任何经验，但是……

sentences.en: And who else?
sentences.zh: 还有谁呢？

sentences.en: Bernie, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 伯尼，我不知道。

sentences.en: No, I don't...
sentences.zh: 不，我没……

sentences.en: He's got a good attitude, but I'm just not certain about his policies.
sentences.zh: 他的态度很好，但我对他的政策不太确定。

sentences.en: So, do you think, like, the party needs to unify around someone?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为党内需要团结在某个人周围吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对需要。

sentences.en: It's just, who do you do?
sentences.zh: 只是，该选谁呢？

sentences.en: Well, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: So, I'll wait till New Hampshire and see what they say, and I'll go from there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会等到新罕布什尔州初选看看他们怎么说，然后再做决定。

sentences.en: But you're voting in New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 但你是在新罕布什尔州投票。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.

sentences.zh: 真抱歉打扰你了。

sentences.en: My name's Lisa Lera.
sentences.zh: 我叫丽莎·勒拉。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter with New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的记者。

sentences.en: Are you a New Hampshire voter?
sentences.zh: 你是新罕布什尔州的选民吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, great.
sentences.zh: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: You're the only one in this industry.
sentences.zh: 你是这一行里唯一的一个。

sentences.en: You're the only one in this entire row.
sentences.zh: 你是整排里唯一的一个。

sentences.en: Are you serious?
sentences.zh: 你是认真的吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm serious.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是认真的。

sentences.en: Have you seen Biden more?
sentences.zh: 你见过拜登不止一次吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，见过。

sentences.en: I think he's, would be an extremely capable leader, yes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他会是一位非常有能力的领导人，是的。

sentences.en: And have you seen Biden more?
sentences.zh: 那你见过拜登不止一次吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have.
sentences.zh: 是的，见过。

sentences.en: Thoughts?
sentences.zh: 有什么想法？

sentences.en: I think he's perfectly capable, too.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得他非常有能力。

sentences.en: I've seen Amy Klobuchar also.
sentences.zh: 我也见过艾米·克洛布查尔。

sentences.en: I have a more severe approach.
sentences.zh: 我的标准比较严格。

sentences.en: I'll drop a candidate if they don't have their act together.
sentences.zh: 如果候选人表现得不够专业，我就不会支持他们。

sentences.en: Do you think Biden has his act together?
sentences.zh: 你觉得拜登表现得专业吗？

sentences.en: No, not at present.
sentences.zh: 不，目前来看没有。

sentences.en: We both like Joe a lot, but that's not where we're going at the present time.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都很喜欢乔，但目前我们不打算支持他。

sentences.en: Where are you going?
sentences.zh: 那你们打算支持谁？

sentences.en: I'm going with Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 我打算支持布隆伯格。

sentences.en: Sorry, my wife is going with Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我妻子打算支持布隆伯格。

sentences.en: I'm going with Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 我打算支持布蒂吉格。

sentences.en: Okay, cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，酷。

sentences.en: All right, well, thank you guys.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 玩得开心。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.en: Good luck, sweetheart.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Half of this crowd up here is from someplace else.
sentences.zh: 这里一半的观众都是从别处来的。

sentences.en: It turns out, in a year where everybody wants to elect a winner, looking like a winner by winning some states really, really matters.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在大家都想选出赢家的这一年里，通过赢得几个州来展现出胜选者的姿态，真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: And that's why Iowa, despite all the chaos, despite all the confusion, is just deeply in the brains of people in New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么尽管爱荷华州充满了混乱和困惑，它依然深深地印在新罕布什尔州选民的脑海里。

sentences.en: On Monday, in their final push across New Hampshire, ahead of today's primary vote, the Democratic
sentences.zh: 周一，在今天初选投票前，民主党候选人在新罕布什尔州进行了最后的冲刺，

sentences.en: candidates, especially the two leading candidates, Bernie Sanders and Pete Buttigieg, made the case that the other's message was a losing one.
sentences.zh: 尤其是两位领先的候选人——伯尼·桑德斯和皮特·布蒂吉格，他们都声称对方的竞选主张是注定失败的。

sentences.en: Knowing how much depends on bringing Americans together, we cannot risk alienating Americans at this critical moment.
sentences.zh: 深知团结美国人的重要性，在这个关键时刻，我们不能冒着疏远美国人的风险。

sentences.en: And that's where I part ways with my friend Senator Sanders.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我与我的朋友桑德斯参议员分道扬镳的地方。

sentences.en: I know Buttigieg warned that Sanders' left-wing proposals could turn off the voters most needed
sentences.zh: 我知道布蒂吉格曾警告说，桑德斯的左翼提案可能会让那些在今年秋季大选中击败特朗普总统最需要的选民感到反感，

sentences.en: to defeat President Trump in this fall's general election, while Sanders sought to energize
sentences.zh: 而桑德斯则试图通过强调布蒂吉格所获得的企业精英支持，来激发他那些反建制支持者的热情。

sentences.en: his anti-establishment supporters by highlighting the support that Buttigieg has received from corporate elites.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，随着两位意识形态截然不同的候选人领跑，

sentences.en: The Times reports that with two ideologically opposed candidates leading the race, the
sentences.zh: 以及三位主要竞争对手——伊丽莎白·沃伦、乔·拜登和势头强劲的艾米·克洛布查尔在争夺第三名，

sentences.en: race, and three leading rivals, Elizabeth Horne, Joe Biden, and a surging Amy Klobuchar jostling for third place.
sentences.zh: 选情十分激烈。

sentences.en: All top five candidates are likely to continue on after tonight's primary, an event that typically ends with candidates dropping out of the race.
sentences.zh: 排名前五的候选人很可能会在今晚的初选后继续参选，而这场活动通常会导致部分候选人退选。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
